caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular chest rendered in black and white with ink lines and shading. The chest has a flat top and is composed of three vertical panels on the front, each featuring intricate engraved patterns; two panels show stylized floral motifs with stems, leaves, and symmetrical flowers, while the central panel displays the letters "M R" with additional decorative elements, including a star and precise linework. Surrounding the panels and covering the horizontal and vertical borders, there are swirling vine-like patterns that add to the ornate appearance. The lower section of the chest's face has further horizontal bands and floral engravings, and its legs are slightly recessed, shown shaded for depth. The right side of the chest is visible, with vertical slats rendered with parallel lines. The artist's signature, "H. Meriam 36," and the notation "SCALE 3/4''" are located at the bottom right corner. The overall composition relies mainly on black ink for patterns and structure, with the natural color of the paper providing the background.
title: Hadley Chest
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
